answer: Use manufacturer-attested, nonexportable sensor keys as a one-device-one-identity defense. At an unpredictable minute, a verifier asks each registered coastal station to sign its live tide reading, the signal strength of a named beacon, and the hash of a nebula image displayed in that station's challenge packet. Reject reused hardware serials and late signatures. A cheater running extra identities must buy separate attested stations and keep each powered and connected.
